morning.insight:
💡 Anthropic IPO 사이클이 바꾼 판

어제 KOSPI가 168P 폭등한 결정타는 엔비디아 실적도, FOMC도 아닌 AI 스타트업의 IPO 한 방이었습니다. Anthropic의 반기 매출 162.9억$는 전년비 13배 — AI가 '비용'에서 '수익 모델'로 전환되는 신호로 읽혔습니다.

다만 10월 KOSPI 누적 하락률이 여전히 -17%라는 점, 개인이 9,478억 차익실현에 나선 점은 반등의 지속성을 의심케 합니다. 오늘 밤 FOMC 결과와 SK하이닉스 실적(내일)이 향후 방향을 가를 변수입니다.

**오늘의 집중**: 9월 경영수지 마감 D-Day — 숫자 하나하나가 11/3 전사전략회의의 재료입니다. 전략회의 준비 밀린 일도 오늘 중 복구가 필요합니다.

articles.headline: Wall Street Extends Anthropic-Driven Rally; GM Jumps 5.5% on Nasdaq Move
articles.body: U.S. stocks rose for a second straight session. The Dow added 0.03% to 52,377.57, the S&P 500 rose 0.60% to 7,722.60, and the Nasdaq gained 1.18% to 26,477.81, led by tech shares.

articles.headline: Anthropic Files for IPO, Eyeing Up to $2 Trillion Valuation
articles.body: Anthropic filed its S-1 seeking a Nasdaq listing under ticker 'ANT'. First-half revenue hit $16.29 billion, up more than 1,300% from a year earlier. Wall Street expects a raise of $100 billion at a $1.5-2 trillion valuation, listing around mid-November.

articles.headline: Meta Expands AI Fundraising to $97.5 Billion
articles.body: Meta raised the size of its Class A stock offering to $25 billion from $22.5 billion, bringing total AI-related fundraising to $97.5 billion and weighing on its shares.

articles.headline: Broadcom Arranges $63 Billion Financing for Anthropic Chips
articles.body: Broadcom said it would arrange $63 billion in financing for Anthropic with Bank of America, Citigroup, Morgan Stanley and Blackstone, boosting AI sentiment.

articles.headline: Fed Meets, Expected to Hold Rates in 3.75%-4% Range
articles.body: The Fed convened for its October policy meeting and is widely expected to hold the fed funds rate at 3.75%-4%, saving a second hike of the year for December.

articles.headline: Boeing Tumbles 10.7% After Wider-Than-Expected Loss
articles.body: Boeing shares fell 10.7% after reporting a bigger-than-expected third-quarter loss, bucking the broader market's AI-led advance.

articles.headline: AI Rally Regains Steam After Anthropic IPO Filing
articles.body: AI stocks rebounded as Anthropic's IPO filing revived enthusiasm, lifting chipmakers. Samsung Electronics and SK hynix each rose more than 4%, driving the Kospi higher.

articles.headline: Asian Stocks Rebound on AI Optimism
articles.body: Asian equities rose about 0.9%, led by Korean and Japanese tech, after Wall Street snapped a two-day losing streak on renewed AI momentum.

articles.headline: Broadcom Closes $63 Billion Chip Financing for Anthropic
articles.body: Broadcom sealed a $63 billion deal with Bank of America, Blackstone, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley to finance chip purchases for Anthropic.

articles.headline: Meta, Broadcom, SpaceX Drive AI Fundraising Wave
articles.body: Meta sought up to $97.5 billion in stock sales, Broadcom closed a $63 billion financing deal, and SpaceX signed a roughly $40 billion equipment lease.

articles.headline: Oil Slides Below $100 on Hopes of Ukraine, Iran Diplomacy
articles.body: Oil closed below $100 a barrel in New York amid reports that diplomatic efforts could resume in Ukraine and Iran. Brent traded near $109.

articles.headline: Treasury Five-Year Auction Shows Cooling Yields
articles.body: The Treasury sold $70 billion in five-year notes at 4.845%, with a bid-to-cover of 2.33, as rates cooled from September's 5.033%.

articles.headline: Trump's 'Learning Curve' on China Ends With Conciliation at Summit
articles.body: The president has shifted the foundations of American policy toward China, throwing aside the adversarial approach of recent years in a summit marked by conciliation.

articles.headline: Justice Dept. Aims to Use Terrorism Laws to Target Mexican Officials
articles.body: In a new tactic, the Justice Department instructed federal prosecutors to build criminal drug cases against Mexican officials using terrorism statutes.

articles.body: Technology shares led a second day of gains as Anthropic's IPO filing renewed optimism about the AI buildout, with chip stocks outperforming.

articles.body: France reeled after protests turned into riots that damaged buildings and shops, with authorities mobilizing tens of thousands of police officers.

articles.body: Fresh inflation data undercut the administration's economic narrative, complicating the GOP's closing midterm message on prices.

articles.body: The Ramaswamy campaign halved the length of an ad featuring Amy Acton's estranged mother after it sparked an uproar, prompting Obama's rebuke.

articles.body: Even if Democrats win control of Congress, lawmakers can do little about prices that remain uncomfortably high as inflation is expected to slow only gradually.

articles.body: More than 70,000 police fanned out across France as hundreds of thousands protested, with stores boarding up after last week's riots.

articles.headline: Ukraine Says Satellite Access Is Back After Days of Disruptions
articles.body: Ukraine said access to Starlink and Starshield services resumed after days of disruptions, with Trump having said he would 'fix' the issue if necessary.

articles.headline: AI Doesn't Need a Conscience. It Needs a Leash.
articles.body: The safest autonomous agents will be surrounded by systems that limit what they can access and do, the Post's editorial board argues.

articles.headline: US Stocks Extend AI-Fuelled Rally as Fed Convenes
articles.body: An AI-fuelled tech rally sent US stocks higher for a second day, with the Nasdaq leading gains as the Fed convened for its penultimate meeting of the year.

articles.headline: Anthropic IPO Filing Reignites AI Trade; Semis Outperform
articles.body: Details of Anthropic's impending IPO boosted chip stocks for a third session, though the Philadelphia semiconductor index remains more than 20% off its June record.

articles.headline: Fed Set to Hold Rates as Traders Bet on December Final Hike
articles.body: The Fed is widely expected to keep the fed funds target at 3.75%-4%, saving its second rate hike of the year for December, according to CME's FedWatch tool.

articles.headline: Meta's $97.5bn AI Fundraising Weighs on Shares
articles.body: Meta increased its largest-ever equity fundraising to $97.5 billion to fund AI expansion, sending its shares down about 1.6%.

articles.headline: Boeing Sinks 10.7% on Wider Loss
articles.body: Boeing tumbled 10.7% after a bigger-than-expected third-quarter loss, the market's biggest laggard amid the broader AI rally.

articles.headline: Oil Retreats Below $100 on Hopes of Ukraine-Iran Diplomacy
articles.body: Oil slipped below the psychologically significant $100 level in New York on reports that diplomatic efforts to stop the war could resume in Ukraine and Iran.
